project_type: Next.js 16 App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4 (no tailwind.config.ts; tokens in app/globals.css @theme), Supabase SSR (@supabase/ssr + @supabase/supabase-js). Single repo (not a monorepo).
build_system: Next.js 16 (`next build`). Tailwind v4 via @tailwindcss/postcss. No Turbopack. No test framework configured — verification is typecheck + build.
test_framework: None. Verification = `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) + `npm run build` (next build).
verification_instructions: 1. `npm run typecheck` — zero type errors. 2. `npm run build` — zero build errors, no deprecated-prop warnings (next/image `priority`/`onLoadingComplete` are deprecated in v16; use `preload={false}`/`onLoad`). 3. The migration SQL (supabase/migrations/19_dance_orgs.sql) is applied operationally (supabase db push / migrate), NOT by the build — sanity-check it is syntactically balanced; do not expect the build to apply it. 4. `npm run logos:sync` requires SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY + network; if unavailable it will produce text-pill fallbacks — that is acceptable and must be reported honestly in LOGO_SOURCES.md/report.md.
snapshot_or_generated_files: public/logos/<slug>.<ext> — logo image files downloaded by `npm run logos:sync`. Commit them (file-based storage; the weekly Vercel cron cannot write /public at runtime, so committed assets are the source of truth for image files). Also: scripts/sync-dance-logos.ts writes these; LOGO_SOURCES.md and .agents/tasks/dance-org-carousel/report.md are authored from sync results.
environment_constraints: 1. Scripts run via `node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/<name>.ts` and CANNOT resolve the `@/` webpack alias — use relative imports with `.ts` extension (see lib/dance/constants.ts header comment and scripts/seed-dance-updates.ts). 2. next/image `priority` is DEPRECATED in v16 — use `preload={false}`; `onLoadingComplete` is DEPRECATED — use `onLoad`. 3. The dance page is dark-only by design (IDL navy/lime/red palette in lib/dance/constants.ts IDL), but the carousel sits in the normal themed surface (bg-card/border-border) like OrgLogoBar — use token classes, never hardcoded hex. 4. Vercel serverless FS is read-only at runtime: the weekly cron calls runDanceLogoSync({writeFiles:true}) which gracefully skips file writes if the FS is not writable, preserving existing committed logo_url assets and refreshing DB status. 5. vercel.json already has a dance-agent cron — MERGE, never overwrite. 6. next.config.ts already has the needed remotePatterns for the updates feed; because logos are LOCAL (/public/logos), do NOT edit next.config.ts. 7. Worktree root is c:\website\GrooveSystem; relative paths in shell commands resolve against the parent workspace, so always cd into the worktree or use absolute paths.
contribution_requirements: Per AGENTS.md: read the relevant guide in node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing Next.js code (Next.js 16 has breaking changes). Reuse existing conventions; do not delete/restructure unrelated files; do not break existing APIs or the DanceBeat Agent; never expose the service-role key. Migration files: sequential numeric naming (next is 19_dance_orgs.sql) with DO $$ IF NOT EXISTS policy guards (see 17_dance_crews.sql). New components go in features/dance/components/ (PascalCase). Scripts go in scripts/ as .ts (node --experimental-strip-types).
key_patterns: 1. Server Supabase read: `import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'; const supabase = await createClient();` (anon key, RLS applies — public SELECT works). Privileged writes use createAdminClient() (service role) or, in scripts, a direct @supabase/supabase-js client with SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY. 2. Server→client data passing: server page fetches, passes plain props to a 'use client' component (cannot import a server fetch inside a client component). 3. Client components: 'use client', import from @/features or @/lib; cn util at @/components/shared/cn. 4. CSS animations: pure @keyframes in app/globals.css; honor prefers-reduced-motion with @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) — see existing blocks. .g-eyebrow and .no-scrollbar exist. 5. OrgLogoBar pill styling (to match for text-pill fallback): border border-border bg-muted/30 text-muted-foreground rounded-full px-* py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold. 6. RLS: ALTER TABLE … ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; CREATE POLICY 'Public read …' FOR SELECT USING (true); service role bypasses RLS so no write policy needed. 7. Cron route: export const dynamic='force-dynamic'; export const maxDuration=…; GET checks CRON_SECRET (Authorization Bearer / ?key= / vercel-cron UA) — see app/api/cron/dance-agent/route.ts.
directory_structure: app/ — Next.js App Router pages + API routes (app/api/cron/dance-agent/route.ts is the cron pattern). app/community/performing-arts/dance/page.tsx (static dance route) and app/community/performing-arts/[discipline]/page.tsx (dynamic route whose dance branch also renders DanceCommunityView). features/dance/components/ — DanceCommunityView ('use client', owns filter state), DanceCommunityHero (hero), OrgLogoBar (text-pill click-to-filter), UpcomingEventsSection, UpdatesFilterBar, UpdateCard. features/dance/services/ — danceService, danceBeatAgent (do not touch). lib/dance/ — constants.ts (import-free by design; ORGANIZATIONS + IDL palette), imageVerification.ts (rejects favicons/SVGs — do NOT reuse for logos), schema.ts. lib/supabase/ — server.ts (createClient anon / createAdminClient service role), client.ts (browser). scripts/ — .ts scripts run via node --experimental-strip-types. supabase/migrations/ — sequential 00..18; next is 19_dance_orgs.sql. public/ — static assets; public/logos/ does NOT exist yet (sync script creates it). vercel.json — has one cron (dance-agent); merge the weekly dance-logos cron.
